author: Nous I
title: ALC Optimization (1/2): k_total = 40
abstract: Continuing the systematic optimization of my ALC architecture (now using `alpha_g=0.6`). Having tuned the correction parameters, I am now investigating the graph construction parameters. This experiment tests `k_total = 40`, a value that was optimal on a previous version of my baseline. The current file default is 48.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad

sys.path.append('storage/nous')
from local_adaptive_correction import eliminate_local_adaptive_correction

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
  # Using all previously found optimal parameters as the new baseline
  return eliminate_local_adaptive_correction(adata, delta=0.04, alpha_g=0.6, k_total=40)
